title: New condition types: rescued, has-dye (hasItem category), bestiary %, season, angler quests, killed/obtained
player_outcome: No visible change on its own. These conditions let later packages use Terraria's real move-in and shop rules: rescued NPCs, carrying a dye, bestiary completion, the Christmas season and angler quest counts.
design: Split ConditionCompiler.cs (164 lines): Factories = Build(), which calls AddWorld(f), AddTown(f) and AddComposites(f). Move coins/maxLife/resident/residents/hasItem into a new ConditionCompiler.Town.cs, and their params classes into ConditionParams.Town.cs.

ConditionContext: add Season (string, '' = none), AnglerQuests (int) and Records (IPlayerRecords?). IPlayerRecords is a new interface in Strata.Core.Conditions: int Kills(string enemy), bool Obtained(string item), float BestiaryPercent {get;}, bool Achieved(string id). P5-25 implements it.

New condition types: rescued {id} → Flags.Contains(TownRescue.FlagFor(id)) with flag 'rescued_<id>'; hasItem gains 'category' (an ItemCategory name, ItemCount key '@<category>'); bestiary {min,max} (percent); season {is: christmas|halloween|none}; anglerQuests {min,max}; killed {enemy, min=1}; obtained {item}; achieved {id}. Each has an IValidatableSpec where it applies.

Season: new Simulation/SeasonCalendar.Of(DateOnly) returns 'christmas' for Dec 15–31 and 'halloween' for Oct 10–Nov 1. New WorldSession.Season.cs: Season => Meta.ForcedSeason ?? SeasonCalendar.Of(today). WorldSession.ContextAt sets ctx.Season. WorldMeta gets a ForcedSeason string (no version bump). WorldCommands gains 'season <auto|none|christmas|halloween>'. Season never touches world generation, so determinism is unaffected.

TownSystem.TownContext: the ItemCount lambda handles '@' category keys; AnglerQuests comes from the local PlayerState (0 until P5-23); Records = _world.Journal?.RecordsFor(player) (null until P5-25; conditions treat null as 0/false).

ContentValidator.Town.CheckTownCondition: check refs for rescued (TownNpcs), killed (Enemies), obtained (Items) and achieved (Achievements once P5-26 exists); ItemCategory names; season values. Probes: season.<name> (1/0).
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Conditions/ConditionCompiler.cs — split into Build() and partial adders
tests: ConditionTests: rescued true only after flag 'rescued_goblin_tinkerer'; hasItem category 'dye' counts an item with category Dye; bestiary min 10 with a fake IPlayerRecords (9.9 → false, 10 → true; null records → false); season with ctx.Season; anglerQuests; killed/obtained
SeasonCalendarTests: Dec 14 none, Dec 15 christmas, Dec 31 christmas, Oct 31 halloween, Nov 2 none
ContentValidatorTests: unknown category → error; rescued with an unknown resident id → error
verification: dotnet run --project tools/Strata.Tools -- validate reports no new errors
risks: Records being null before P5-25 means bestiary-gated content stays locked until then. This is intended; say so in the PR.
